text:
Situation: Water 1 mL/mL 10 mL vials are low at Corvale East with 8 vials and 2.4 days on hand. Corvale General has 46 vials and 10.6 days. Corvale Lakeside has 7 vials and 9.7 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show water is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is critically low at East. General and Lakeside have adequate stock for now. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place immediate order with American Regent, Inc. for Corvale East; requires pharmacy director approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate B. Braun Medical Inc. as secondary source for all sites; requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Civica, Inc. (Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.) as tertiary source; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage at all three sites and report to P&T committee weekly; requires P&T chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Delaying purchase for East pending committee meeting. Initiating conservation protocols without clinical team request. Using unvetted suppliers not listed above.
